name: Lived happily, ever after
source:
Mabel is a girl who lived her life persecuted due to the town's legend: "Those with black hair are descendants of demons." One day, the mayor orders her to serve at a vampire's mansion on the hill outside town. 

Though terrified, Mabel heads to the mansion, where she encounters a young man who looks kind at first glance...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11352]NovelGame[/url]]
